- Totals present: "Netto EUR 7.103,36", "+10 % USt EUR 710,34", "Brutto EUR 7.813,70" → clear monetary totals.

  - Bottom block: "UID-Nr. ATU41678500" in company footer — corresponds to sender (seller).
- Per field Sender.VatId, use sender/seller UID = "ATU41678500".

- Extracted directly as "31.01.2024" from "Rosenburg, am 31.01.2024".

- Net line: "Netto EUR 7.103,36" → Net.Amount = 7103.36 (preserve decimals).
- VAT line: "+10 % USt EUR 710,34" → Vat.Rate = 10 (no %), Vat.Amount = 710.34.
- Gross/Grand total: "Brutto EUR 7.813,70" → GrandTotal.Amount = 7813.70.

5) Verify no inference beyond visible data
- All values taken exactly from invoice text; no guessing.
- Decimal commas converted to decimal points; decimal places preserved.

6) Map to schema types
- GrandTotal.Amount: 7813.70 (number)
- Invoice.Date: "31.01.2024" (string)
- Sender.VatId: "ATU41678500" (string)
- Vat.Rate: 10 (number)
- Net.Amount: 7103.36 (number)
- Vat.Amount: 710.34 (number)
